prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type, and the presenting symptoms are plausible given that mechanism. Over the course of fifteen visits, care followed a typical conservative pathway that included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment intensity was reduced in a stepwise fashion as symptoms improved and function returned. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the reported soft tissue injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body regions is known to this office. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue an independent home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen.
